textPool.name: caravans
textPool.entry: the spice caravan of Master Oduin

textPool.name: expeditions
textPool.entry: the cartographers of the Ivory Tower

textPool.name: bountyClues
textPool.entry: Fresh claw marks and a torn pack - {target} passed here not long ago.
A half-eaten carcass. {target} is close, and still hungry.
Tracks, deep and heavy, lead away into the wilds. The radar shows where.

textPool.name: kidnapClues
textPool.entry: A torn ribbon caught on a thorn - {hostage} came this way.
Boot prints, several of them, and drag marks. They are not far.
A dropped token of {gang}. So that is who took {hostage}.
Ashes of a campfire, still warm. The trail goes on.

textPool.name: expeditionClues
textPool.entry: A broken surveyor's rod, stamped with the mark of {expedition}.
A journal page: "...the beasts came at night, we ran north..."
An abandoned camp. The tents are slashed, the fire long cold.
Blood on the rocks, and a trail of dropped supplies.
A signal flag, planted in haste. Someone wanted to be found.

textPool.name: rareBeasts
textPool.entry: the White Hart of the Hollows

textPool.name: treasureClues
textPool.entry: Here! The ground is soft and freshly turned - someone buried something.
The landmarks match the map. Dig here.

textPool.name: manhuntClues
textPool.entry: A farmer saw {fugitive} pass by at dawn, heading into the wilds.
A bloodied cloak, left behind in haste. The trail goes on.
A cold camp and a stolen purse. {fugitive} is close.

textPool.name: beastTracks
textPool.entry: Huge tracks, pressed deep into the earth. It passed here.
Torn bark, high up on a tree. It is bigger than you thought.
Fresh droppings. It isn't far now.
A tuft of {beast}'s fur caught on a thorn.

textPool.name: childClues
textPool.entry: A small shoe, lost in the grass. {child} came this way.
Someone heard crying from the woods over there.
A doll, dropped by the path. The tracks go on.

textPool.name: scoutLines
textPool.entry: From up here you can see their camps. You note them down.
You count their fires and watch the patrols change.
A good view of the passes. The board will want this.

textPool.name: watchLines
textPool.entry: All quiet at this post. On to the next.
Something moves out there in the dark...
The torch at this post had gone out. You light it again.

template.name: Wanted: {target}

stage.name: The Last Sighting
stage.text: {target} was last seen near {near}. Search the place on your radar for its trail.

on.text: The trail has gone cold.

stage.name: The Hunt
stage.text: The trail leads on. {target} is somewhere ahead - follow the radar and finish it.

objective.fleeText: {target} caught your scent and fled! Follow the radar.

on.text: Among the remains: a token of {gang}. There will be more of them.
{target} has slipped away to a new lair! You have one more chance.

template.text: Wanted
A beast of the wilds has grown bold and killed travellers near the roads. The board pays well for its head. Its trail starts in the hunting grounds of your strength.
The bounty is yours. The roads are a little safer tonight.
You there! A bounty has been posted, and you look like a hunter.

template.name: Caravan Crossing

stage.name: The Caravan Master
stage.text: {caravan} waits at the edge of the wilds near {near}. Find its master on your radar.

objective.dialog: The road ahead is thick with brigands and worse. We leave now, with you leading. Keep them off the wagon and we'll all live to see town.

stage.name: The Crossing
stage.text: Lead the wagon towards {dest}. When it stops, the ambushers come - beat them off.

objective.startText: Hyah! Lead the way, we follow.
objective.arriveText: We're through! You've earned your pay.
objective.failText: The wagon is lost, and the cargo with it.

on.text: The caravan master whispers: the brigands answer to someone. The board will want to know.

template.text: Caravan Crossing
A caravan must cross dangerous land and no guard can be spared. Lead it from the wilds to the next town and keep the wagon in one piece.
The caravan made it through. The merchants pay what they promised, and a little more.
You left the caravan to its fate.
Adventurer! A caravan needs an escort, right now. Will you help?

template.name: Kidnapped: {hostage}

stage.name: The Trail
stage.text: {hostage} was taken on the road near {near}. Find out where they went.

on.text: The trail has gone cold. {hostage} is lost.

stage.name: The Hideout
stage.text: The trail ends at {gang}'s hideout. Clear it out before they move {hostage} again.

on.text: {gang} moved {hostage} to another hideout - and their leader is with them now!

stage.name: The Way Home
stage.text: {hostage} is free, but shaken. Lead them safely towards {dest}.

objective.startText: Thank the gods... please, get me home.
objective.ambushText: They are coming back for me!
objective.arriveText: Home... I never thought I'd see it again.
objective.failText: {gang} took {hostage} back, and this time for good.

on.text: {hostage} heard their leader's name. The board will post a bounty.

template.text: Kidnapped!
{requester} begs for help: someone dear was dragged off the road by brigands. Follow their trail, free the captive and bring them home.
{hostage} is home, and a whole town owes you.
With nobody left to follow the trail, {hostage} is lost.
Please, adventurer! They took someone - brigands, on the road! Help us!

template.name: Order for {requester}

stage.name: The Order
stage.text: Bring {goods} to a Notice Board for {requester}.

objective.name: lumps of cold iron
objective.text: If you can, bring cold iron from the {monster} near {near} too.

template.text: Blacksmith's Order
{requester} has more orders than materials. Bring what the forge needs - the grade you work with yourself - and be paid well above the shop price.
The forge roars again. {requester} pays in coin and in favours.

template.name: A Favour for {requester}

objective.text: Bring {goods} to a Notice Board for {requester}.
Carry {requester}'s letter to the Notice Board of {dest}.
Thin out the {monster} near {near} that trouble {requester}.

template.text: A Favour
{requester} needs a hand with something small. It won't take long, and they will remember it.
{requester} thanks you warmly.

template.name: Outbreak of {monster}

stage.name: The Surge
stage.text: The {monster} near {near} are multiplying. Trim them down before they spread!

on.text: The outbreak spreads, and an alpha leads it!

template.text: Outbreak
Outbreak! The {monster} near {near} are multiplying out of control. Hunters of level {level} or so, trim them down!
The outbreak near {near} has been trimmed down. Well fought!
The outbreak near {near} could not be stopped. The beasts scatter into the land.
The surge is broken. Everyone who fought shares the reward.

template.name: Hold the Line

stage.name: The Camp
stage.text: {captain}'s camp near {near} expects an attack. Report to the captain.

objective.dialog: Our scouts saw them gathering - too many for us alone. Stand by our banner. If it falls, the camp falls with it.

stage.name: The Assault
stage.text: Defend the banner through every wave, and break their leader.

on.text: The banner has fallen, and the camp with it.

template.text: Hold the Line
A camp in the wilds is about to be overrun. Its captain asks for anyone who can hold a line.
The camp stands. {captain} salutes you.
You left the camp to its fate.
The camp nearby is under attack! They need every blade - come quickly!

template.name: The Lost Expedition

stage.name: The Trail
stage.text: {expedition} vanished near {near}. Follow their traces.

on.text: The trail is lost. {expedition} will never be found.

stage.name: The Survivor
stage.text: One of {expedition} is alive! Lead the survivor towards {dest}.

objective.startText: You found me... I can walk, if you lead.
objective.arriveText: Safe at last. The others... I'll tell the board everything.

on.text: The survivor speaks of a second camp, further out.

stage.name: The Culprit
stage.text: Nobody survived. Something lairs where the trail ends - {beast}. Slay it.

on.text: In its lair: a map of the expedition's route - and a second camp, further out.
{beast} has gone to ground.

template.text: The Lost Expedition
An expedition into the wilds has not come back. Find out what happened to them - and bring back anyone you can.
You learned the expedition's fate. The board records your name.
You left the trail, and it has gone cold.
You have sharp eyes. An expedition went missing near here - will you look for them?

template.name: The Nests near {near}

stage.name: The Nests
stage.text: Nests are breeding {monster} near {near}. Stand next to each nest to burn it, while their brood fights back.

on.text: The nests are swarming, and their mother has come!

template.text: Monster Nests
The hunting grounds teem with more beasts every day: something is breeding them. Find the nests and burn them.
The nests are ash. The land can breathe again.
The nests breed on without you.
All this slaughter has stirred the nests nearby. Someone has to burn them - you?

template.name: Urgent Courier

stage.name: The Package
stage.text: Carry the sealed package to the Notice Board of {dest} on foot. A teleport breaks the seal.

objective.teleportText: The seal shatters as you pass through the ether - the package is ruined.

template.text: Urgent Courier
A sealed package must reach another town, and it can't go through the gatekeepers - the seal breaks in the ether. Carry it on foot, and watch the roads.
The package arrives, seal unbroken. The recipient pays the courier's fee.
The package never arrived.

template.name: The Treasure Map

stage.name: X Marks the Spot
stage.text: The map shows a spot near {near}. Find it and search the ground.

objective.text: Find the spot the map marks near {near}.

on.text: The map's ink has run - the spot is lost.

stage.name: Digging
stage.text: You found the chest! Its old guardians are stirring. Keep them off it while it comes loose.

objective.startText: The lid creaks... something is coming!
objective.failText: The chest was smashed to splinters.

template.text: Treasure Map
Among the remains you find a torn map with a mark on it.
A torn map, old and stained, with an X drawn near the hunting grounds you know. Someone buried something there - and didn't come back for it.
The old chest holds coin and more. Whoever buried it won't miss it.
The map crumbles to dust in your pack.

template.name: Manhunt: {fugitive}

stage.name: Word on the Street
stage.text: {fugitive} was last seen near {near}. Follow the trail.

on.text: The trail has gone cold. {fugitive} got away.

stage.name: The Arrest
stage.text: {fugitive} hides ahead. They fight like any adventurer - be ready.

objective.title: {fugitive}
objective.revealText: {fugitive}: You should have stayed in town!
objective.fleeText: {fugitive} slipped away again! Follow the radar.

on.text: {fugitive} slipped away to a new hiding place!

template.text: Manhunt
A deserter turned murderer hides in the wilds. The board wants them stopped. They fight like an adventurer, and they won't come quietly. Killing them is lawful: no karma.
Justice is done. The board pays the bounty.
With nobody on the trail, the fugitive is long gone.

template.name: Corrupted Ground near {near}

stage.name: The Taint
stage.text: Totems near {near} are poisoning the land and the beasts. Stand next to each one to cleanse it.

objective.nestText: Black ooze seeps from the totem. Stand next to it to cleanse it.
objective.swarmText: The corruption fights back - its heart has awoken!
objective.motherSlainText: The heart of the corruption is destroyed!

on.text: The corruption spreads faster!

template.text: Corrupted Ground
Something has tainted a hunting ground: the beasts there are sick and savage. Find the corrupted totems and cleanse them.
The land is clean again. The beasts calm down.
The corruption spreads unchecked.

template.name: Tracking {beast}

stage.name: The Tracks
stage.text: {beast} was sighted near {near}. Follow its tracks.

on.text: The tracks are washed away. {beast} is gone.

stage.name: The Beast
stage.text: The tracks end ahead. {beast} is there - strong, and wary.

on.text: {beast} has fled deeper into the wilds!

template.text: Rare Beast
A beast of legend has been seen: hunters have tried and failed to take it. Follow its tracks and bring it down.
You took the beast of legend. Hunters will talk about this.

template.name: Intercept {gang}

stage.name: The Interception
stage.text: {gang} are moving contraband through the land near {near}. Catch them and break their boss before they reach the meeting point.

objective.killText: The boss is down - the contraband is seized!
objective.arriveText: {gang} reached their buyers and vanished. Too late.

template.text: Smuggler Interception
Smugglers move goods through the wilds under the guards' noses. The board knows their route - not for how long. Catch them on the move.
The contraband is seized and the board pays a share of it.
The smugglers got through.

template.name: The Lost Child: {child}

stage.name: The Search
stage.text: {child} wandered off near {near}. Look for signs of where they went.

on.text: Night falls, and {child} is still out there. Others will keep looking.

stage.name: The Way Home
stage.text: You found {child}! Lead them home to {town} - and don't run ahead, or they'll wander off again.

objective.failText: {child} ran off in fright and is lost again.

template.text: The Lost Child
{requester} is beside themselves: a child wandered off into the wilds. Find them and bring them home - gently.
{child} is home safe. {requester} can't thank you enough.
Others will have to find the child now.

template.name: Fish for {requester}
template.text: Fisherman's Request
{requester} has an order to fill and too few hands. Catch fish in the waters near {town}. A few caught with a night lure would fetch a better price.
{requester} weighs the catch and nods: a fair day's work.

template.name: Scout the Frontier

stage.name: The Vantage Points
stage.text: Reach the vantage points near {near} and watch from each (sitting helps). If anything sees you and attacks, the scouting is ruined.

objective.seenText: You were seen - the enemy knows they are watched now. The scouting is ruined.
objective.text: Watch from the vantage points near {near} without being seen.

template.text: Scout the Frontier
The board needs eyes on the frontier: who camps where, and how many. Watch from the high places - and don't get caught.
Your report is worth its weight in gold.

template.name: The Levy of {castle}

objective.text: Clear the {monster} from the lands of {castle} near {near}.

template.text: Lord's Levy
{lord}, lord of {castle}, posts a levy: the beasts of the castle's lands must be thinned, and the castle pays half again on top of the board's reward, from its own treasury.
{lord} is pleased with your work.

template.name: Race for {target}

stage.name: The Sighting
stage.text: {target} was seen near {near}. Others read the same notice - be quick.

on.text: The rivals got there first.

stage.name: The Race
stage.text: {target} is ahead - and so are rival adventurers who want the bounty for themselves.

objective.title: Rival Adventurer
objective.revealText: Rival adventurers! They want the bounty too!

on.text: The rivals took {target} while you dawdled.

template.text: Rival Adventurers
A rich bounty is posted, and you are not the only one who read it. A rival party is already on its way. Get there first.
The bounty is yours, and the rivals go home empty-handed.

template.name: Rifts near {near}

stage.name: The Rifts
stage.text: Rifts have torn open near {near}, and beasts of {foreignLand} crawl through. Stand next to each rift to seal it.

objective.nestText: The air tears open here, and things from far away crawl through. Stand next to the rift to seal it.
objective.swarmText: The rifts widen - a warden comes through!

on.text: The rifts are widening!

template.text: Rift Closing
Strange rifts are opening in the land, and creatures from far-off places come through them. Seal the rifts before the land is overrun.
The rifts are sealed. The strange creatures fade away.
The rifts stay open.

template.name: Herbs for {requester}

objective.name: fever herbs
objective.nodeText: A fever herb. Careful - the roots are fragile.

on.text: The fever has run its course without the herbs.

objective.text: Hurry the herbs to {requester} in {town} before they wilt.

on.text: The herbs have wilted. Too late.

template.text: Herbalist's Plague
A fever is spreading through the town, and {requester} needs fresh herbs from the wilds - fast, before they wilt.
The fever breaks. {requester} weeps with relief.

template.name: The Night Watch of {town}

stage.name: The Watch
stage.text: Walk the watch posts around {town} and check each one. Things come out of the dark at night.

on.text: The watch is over, and you didn't finish your round.

template.text: Night Watch
The town watch is short of hands tonight. Walk the posts around the town until your round is done. Only at night - the watch ends at dawn.
Your round is done and the town sleeps safe.
Dawn breaks before your round is done. The day watch takes over.
You left your post.

template.name: Guild Contract

on.text: The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.
The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.

objective.text: Follow the trail the guild marked near {near}.

on.text: The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.
The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.

template.text: Guild Contract
The adventurers' guild has contracts for reliable hands. Finish one and they may offer the next; five in a row and the guild names you its champion. You can stop whenever you like.
The guild pays and notes your name.
The guild gives the contract to someone else.
